title: Anti-Ragging
intro: Ragging is a criminal offence and is strictly prohibited at Chirayu Medical College & Hospital.

blocks.title: National Anti-Ragging Helpline
blocks.body:
The **National Anti-Ragging Help Line** is available 24×7.

**Toll free number: [1800-180-5522](tel:18001805522)**

Students can also report ragging to any member of the college Anti-Ragging Committee listed below.
